title: Minimum Size Subarray with Sum >= K
statement:
Given an array of positive integers and a target K, find the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is greater than or equal to K.

If no such subarray exists, print 0.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated positive integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum subarray length with sum >= K, or 0 if impossible.

examples.explanation: Single element 4 already satisfies the condition.

starterCode.python:
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: expand right, shrink left while sum >= k
